name: What is included in a standard tiny home shell package?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a standard tiny home shell package?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our standard tiny home shell package typically includes a professionally framed structure, a weather-tight roof, exterior siding, and installed windows and doors. The foundation (skid or trailer base) is also included. We focus on providing a secure and durable exterior envelope, ready for you to complete the interior systems like plumbing, electrical, insulation, and all finishes. Specific inclusions can be detailed in a custom proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard tiny home shell package includes a framed structure, roof, exterior siding, windows, doors, and the foundation.
